description: A comprehensive Bash script providing helper functions and commands to manage OpenClaw within Docker, including setup, container control, configuration management, device pairing, status checks, and user interface integration.

methods.name: _clr_cmd
methods.description: Outputs styled command text in green and bold for visual emphasis.

methods.name: _cmd
methods.description: Stylized inline command output for sentences.

methods.name: _clawdock_filter_warnings
methods.description: Filters out warning and timing lines from command output.

methods.name: _clawdock_trim_quotes
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string.

methods.name: _clawdock_mask_value
methods.description: Obscures sensitive values, showing placeholders depending on length.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_config_dir
methods.description: Reads the OpenClaw configuration directory path from the config file.

methods.name: _clawdock_ensure_dir
methods.description: Ensures CLAWDOCK_DIR is set and points to a valid Docker setup, auto-detects if necessary.

methods.name: _clawdock_compose
methods.description: Wraps docker compose commands with correct project files and optional extra configuration.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_env_token
methods.description: Reads the OpenClaw gateway token from the environment configuration.
